outcome: mode of delivery (caesarean section, preterm labor)
cohort: 150 pregnant women, mostly confirmed positive for COVID-19 by PCR, whose pregnancies occurred between September 1, 2020, and May 1, 2021.
finding: The study found no significant effect of COVID-19 infection on overall maternal and fetal outcomes in pregnancy.
mod_finding: A slightly increased rate of caesarean section (CS) was observed in infected pregnant women compared to the typical population, even after excluding obstetric indications for CS.
